TechStack.title: What I use day to day

art-jatie.name: Art Jatie
art-jatie.tagline: Art Jatie: e-commerce platform with multi-model AI assistant
art-jatie.description: An e-commerce site selling Malagasy art with an AI assistant and a complete admin interface for a craft e-commerce store: point-of-sale system, order management, production planning, customer reviews.
features: Point of sale (POS) with change calculation and MVola / Orange Money payment.
Kanban production planning: to make, in progress, ready to ship.
Customer review moderation and real-time order tracking.

budgy.name: Budgy
budgy.tagline: Budgy: multi-tenant expense management SaaS with HTMX
budgy.description: A multi-tenant SaaS application built with Django, where each organization has its own isolated PostgreSQL schema via django-tenants, accessible through a dedicated subdomain. The interface relies on HTMX for smooth navigation without a separate JavaScript frontend.
features: Real multi-tenancy with per-schema PostgreSQL isolation and automatic subdomain routing via Traefik.
Dashboard with monthly KPIs and interactive charts (Chart.js): category breakdown, 6-month evolution.
HTMX navigation (hx-boost) for near-instant page loads without full page reloads.

crm-call-center.name: CRM Call Center
crm-call-center.tagline: CRM Call Center: automated follow-ups and outbound call campaigns
crm-call-center.description: A custom Odoo module built for a B2B sales setting team receiving leads to process daily. It turns the standard CRM into a real call center tool: prioritized call queue, multi-day automated follow-ups, and a call widget built directly into the interface.
features: Smart call queue sorted by priority based on follow-up day, automatically excluding already-processed leads.
Automated follow-up engine: switches morning/afternoon then reschedules for the next day, up to 6 attempts before closing.
Scheduled task (cron) that reactivates pending leads once the follow-up time is reached, with no manual action needed.
Custom call widget (OWL) with one-click qualification: voicemail, callback, scheduled callback, meeting, out of scope, wrong number.

gioia-adventure.name: Gioia Adventure
gioia-adventure.tagline: Gioia Adventure: Joomla showcase site for a Nosy Be tour operator
gioia-adventure.description: A multilingual showcase site (French / Italian) for Gioia Adventure, a tour operator based in Hell-Ville, Nosy Be, offering excursions, tours, and catamaran cruises across Madagascar. Built on Joomla with a category-based content architecture and o2switch shared hosting.
features: Joomla template integration and customization: brand-specific visual identity, responsive layout, dedicated sections per offer type (excursions, tours, cruises).
Multilingual FR/IT content structure with per-language articles, menus, and navigation.
o2switch hosting setup and on-page SEO targeting Nosy Be and Madagascar tourism searches.
